scope: Map colors, decorative relief shading, source-image sharpness and road visibility only

palette.role: Illustrative display styling, not vegetation, fuel, burn-state or historical imagery evidence
palette.mountain_gradient: Continuous dark shading based on the validated 50-metre display-height mesh, increasing from 250 to 1300 metres; no change to elevation or terrain physics
palette.illustrated_relief: Source-hue-preserving brightness and illustrative directional highlights/neutral shadows calculated from the validated height mesh; does not add or move terrain, roads, settlements or vegetation
palette.sharpening: One-pixel capped luminance detail; no generated terrain, roads, buildings or vegetation

imagery.registration: Accepted OpenLayers render-frame extent in EPSG:25830; crop source padding before stitching north-first
imagery.guards: Reject stale-size frames, missing drawable canvases, fully transparent captures and empty cropped panels
imagery.fallback: Cancel failed mosaic; use the existing registered single capture without claiming mosaic detail
imagery.limits: More texture pixels do not establish a measured satellite ground resolution or reconstruct 2021 imagery; capture dates remain provider-dependent

roads.source: 21 existing hash-verified OSM map replies; no new road acquisition
roads.style: Brighter cream main roads and warm local roads with contrasting outlines, weaker dashed tracks/paths; exaggerated widths are visual emphasis, not measurements

validation.status: Visual iteration in progress; tests deferred at user request
validation.previous_version: Earlier frontend checks are not a validation of the new visual styling
